mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining GDP, or the correlation between GDP decline and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production index by more than 1% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, which is a strong signal of economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increase > 0.3% and PAYEMS decrease > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a rise in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) suggests a shift in consumer spending from durable goods to services, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as service-oriented sectors benefit.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decrease > 5% and RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a supportive monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of low CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strong demand environment, which positively impacts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods with increasing GDP, or the correlation between GDP growth and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
